eyebrow: Check the machine, not the GPO
code:
gpresult /h C:\Reports\rsop.html /f

Open the HTML report:
  "Winning GPO" column shows which GPO
  actually set each setting on THIS machine
caption: A baseline being linked doesn't mean it won every setting — precedence can quietly override it.

steps.label: WMI filter

steps.label: Slow-link detection

eyebrow: What a red team actually found
code:
Credential-dump attempt, 20 hardened workstations:
  18/20   Credential Guard blocked it, as designed
   2/20   succeeded — imaged before the baseline
          existed, GPO never applied
caption: Secure Score kept climbing for months. It never saw those two machines.
